metadata.description: Self-report screening questionnaire for autistic traits in adolescents and adults with average or above-average intelligence.
metadata.intended_use: Research and initial autism-trait screening; not a diagnostic assessment.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a dimensional self-report measure of autistic traits in adults and adolescents.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Social skills, attention switching, attention to detail, communication, and imagination represent different trait domains.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Cutoffs are screening aids and vary with population; German translation quality and diagnostic follow-up must be considered.

versions.source_citation: Baron-Cohen et al. (2001). The Autism-Spectrum Quotient (AQ): evidence from Asperger syndrome/high-functioning autism, males and females, scientists and mathematicians.
